defects.description: Code token/key modified: 'role_agent_config' was translated to 'Роль_agent_config'.
Incorrect translation of 'safe value' as 'безопасного замечания' (safe remark/note). Should be 'безопасного значения'.
Incorrect translation of 'applied defaults' as 'применённые замечания по умолчанию' (applied remarks by default). Should be 'применённые значения по умолчанию'.

Incorrect translation of 'never inferred' as 'никогда не выводится'. In this context, 'inferred' refers to logical deduction/guessing of a value, whereas 'выводится' typically means 'is outputted/printed'.
Grammatically incorrect and awkward phrasing for 'analytical-task reviews'.
